parsed.explanation: The upper bound relies on (5), but the only justification explicitly leaves the cut count unproved. A single counting sentence would suffice: the A-row needs at most |B|-1 cuts from internal B-boundaries plus possibly one at q, while the B-row needs at most |A|-1 cuts from internal A-boundaries, totaling at most |A|+|B|-1. No other passage supplies this argument.
